title: Ruralia SMP Pack
description: A modpack that focus on a variety of balanced mods, to be used mostly for the Ruralia SMP, run by the streamer k4rm2 and his friend SilentCrossSip. This modpack is made to work well with the Earth maps from motfe, implementing tech and magic features.
body:
This is the Modpack of the Ruralia SMP, run by the  k4rm2 and SilentCrossSip, made spefically to work with the Motfe Earth Maps, and to be balanced while giving good performance. A variety of mods, including tech and magic mods, are present, and some dimensions, like the Aether, are also included. 
This modpack includes some mods downloaded externally:
Aquaculture 2: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aquaculture]
Ars Nouveau: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ars-nouveau]
Ars Elemental [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ars-elemental]
MrCrayfish's framework: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/framework]
MrCrayfish's Refurbished Furniture Mod: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/refurbished-furniture]
